summary: Frontend-only verification of the Kodama Talk Door redesign (/alex). All 3 reported UX complaints and all listed regressions pass. Identity header ('You're knocking at' eyebrow + PlaceMark 76 + door-place-name 'Alex Rivera' + address plaque + italic tagline + door-note) renders clearly; single focused door-paper composer with Write/Preview toggle works; verbose 'Write naturally...' hint is gone; 'This is my place — unlock it' pill is prominently visible at the bottom (bordered talk-pill, ~217x37, centered) and opens unlock-view. Drop send (anonymous), origin switching (named->drop-name, place->drop-from-address), unlock with 'secret' -> owner shelf, and unclaimed-slug claim path all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: door-screen.tsx is 349 lines with DoorView + ClaimView + UnlockView co-located; consider splitting for maintainability but not urgent.

resume-owner banner is per-browser-context localStorage; not testable across headless contexts. Behavior confirmed logically via unlockOwner(remember=true) path but not cross-session verified in this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Door redesign is stable. Tests to reuse: /alex identity header (door-place-name='Alex Rivera'), door-note visible, door-writemode/write-tab/preview-tab toggles preview markdown correctly, 'Write naturally' string absent, this-is-me is a visible bordered pill at bottom (~217x37px), origin-anonymous/named/place work, door-send reaches drop-sent, this-is-me -> unlock-view -> 'secret' -> shelf-rail, /somebodynew shows claim-this-btn. Preview URL: https://door-shelf.preview.emergentagent.com. reduced-motion emulation is required to avoid entrance-animation blank frames.
